rules.statement: A purchaser at a Fiscal's sale may apply under section 284 of the Civil Procedure Code to set aside the sale on the ground that the person whose property he purchased had no saleable interest therein, even after such sale has been confirmed.
rules.supporting_quote: "A purchaser at a Fiscal's sale may apply under section 284 of the Civil Procedure Code to set aside the sale on the ground that the person whose property he purchased had no saleable interest therein) even after such sale has been confirmed and the transfer executed."
